# Weavster — Agent Context Index

Source of truth for coding agents building the Weavster MVP.

## Canonical artifacts

- [../agentic-manifest.json](../agentic-manifest.json) — machine-readable build plan (20 modules, dependencies, acceptance criteria, frameworks)
- [../docs/agent-onboarding.md](../docs/agent-onboarding.md) — coding rules (language, linters, tests, build/container commands, ports)
- [../docs/mvp-project-plan.md](../docs/mvp-project-plan.md) — narrative MVP plan (scope, stack, build sequence)
